name: Oval Floater Key Tag
description: Give marine sport enthusiasts an easy way to remember your brand with this oval floater key tab. This soft, squeezable key tab includes a beaded keychain and is the perfect complement to boat and Jet Ski keys. When buoyancy matters, this key tag is here for you. Polyurethane foam construction floats in water, preventing emergencies on the water. Add an imprint and spread the word about your boat dealership and supple shop, tackle outlet and more.
